patterns.note: Content sections frequently utilize an asymmetrical two-column layout, pairing a large, full-bleed image or solid color block with a text content area.
A warm, earthy two-tone color scheme, primarily reddish-brown and light cream, dominates the background and large content blocks, creating a distinct brand identity.
Headings are set in a bold, uppercase sans-serif font, providing strong visual hierarchy, while body text uses a more readable, lighter sans-serif.
The age gate functions as a fixed-position full-screen overlay, allowing the underlying page content to scroll behind it before the gate is dismissed.
A repeating horizontal text element ('Drink Chilled, Stay Bubbly') acts as a decorative branding motif or divider between content blocks.

technique_notes: The site employs a full-screen age gate as a fixed overlay, which remains static while the content behind it can be scrolled. No scroll-triggered reveal animations, parallax, or sticky elements are observed on the main homepage content based on the provided scroll sequence.

Content sections are designed with a split layout, featuring large visual elements (images or solid color blocks) on one side and textual information on the other, often with generous internal padding.
A continuous horizontal text scroll effect is used for a decorative and branding element, creating a dynamic visual rhythm across the page.

design_tokens.type_scale: Bold, uppercase headings are significantly larger than body text, creating a strong hierarchy, with a distinct condensed display font used for decorative elements.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners are applied to interactive elements like buttons and input fields, while most other elements maintain sharp edges.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, characterized by generous padding around content blocks and ample vertical spacing between distinct sections.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a warm, earthy two-tone color palette combined with bold, uppercase typography creates a sophisticated yet approachable brand identity. The full-page age gate and the horizontally scrolling text element add a unique, memorable touch that sets it apart from generic templates.
